title: Shinonome Ena — An Overwhelming Welcome!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's time. I need to log in...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heya! Wait, huh?
Am I the last one to arrive?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. But I also just got here. I beat you by a nose.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay! Then, I'm glad that I didn't make you all wait too much.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, Amia, you sound really excited for some reason.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, your voice sounds a bit more energetic than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe... I guess the cat's out of the bag. I actually have some good news for you all today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Guess what?!
My big sis is coming back to Japan for work soon♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Your big sister? Doesn't she work as a designer overseas?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Correctomundo!
I really appreciate you remembering her name♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, Enanan, you haven't met her yet, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, I haven't. I really wanna know what she's like.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But what did you mean when you said she's coming to Japan for work?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The company where my sister works is gonna run a pop-up store over here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And she's gonna be serving customers in order to see their reactions and stuff firsthand.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Based on what I heard last time, she's just as excitable and talkative as Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to thank her for the scrunchies we got during New Year's, so I'd love to meet her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if she's coming here for work, then it probably wouldn't be right of me to ask for a meeting.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, also! I'm gonna go pick her up at the airport when she arrives.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, the night before... Or that morning, technically? I'll be wrapping things up a bit early so that I can wake up on time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Anyway, let's get to work.
I'll be on mute for a while, but let me know if you need anything from me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I need to get going on that sketch.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki just posted something in chat...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The website for the pop-up store looks like it's up, so here's a link to it! Check it out when you get a chance.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... I think I'll take a look now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, this website is so trendy...
When are they gonna be open?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess this is just their way of saying that the pop-up store is happening, but they're not putting anything else out yet. Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They have pictures of the clothes they sold the last time they did this! Lemme see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, whoa! What's with this design...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see asymmetrical clothing all the time, but I've never seen anything where the left half looks this different from the right half.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And yet, it still works as one piece of clothing. Somehow it all feels balanced...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This one, on the other hand, is more subdued, but it's covered in all these bows of different colors. It's like you're being surrounded by butterflies... That's really beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's really got that overseas appeal, somehow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Japanese companies and apparel shops don't really make or carry clothes with these kinds of designs.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I wonder if Kanade and Mafuyu already taken a look.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu probably won't give much of a reaction, but I would like to hear what Kanade has to say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, she said she'd mute herself while she works, so she might not have seen it yet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Now I'm even more curious about this pop-up store.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Where are they gonna do it?
Mizuki didn't seem to have any details, so maybe if I look somewhere else...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, they have a social media account.
I'll follow them just in case.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Mizuki's big sister, and this pop-up store... Suddenly I've got a lot to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway, I really need to get to work already.
I've gotta get that sketch done.
